title: OpenBars run completion status (schema v1)
description: One document per `openbars run`, written to <storage.path>/_status/runs/<run_id>.json, mirrored to latest.json and to sessions/<market>/<interval>/<session_date>.json. Contains no credentials, no DSNs, no absolute user paths and no webhook URLs. See docs/run-status.md.

run_id.description: Unique per invocation: UTC compact timestamp plus 6 random hex digits. Never reused.

command.description: The CLI command that produced this document.

outcome.description: noop: nothing was planned; skipped: work was planned but none of it ran (for example the request budget was not accepted); success: every executed job finished; partial: some finished and some did not; failed: nothing finished and at least one job did not.

jobs.description: Job counters for this invocation only.

sessions.description: One entry per (market, interval, session_date) this run wrote rows for or failed to finish.

error.description: Short top-level summary when outcome is failed or partial; null otherwise. Never contains a path, URL or credential.

notifications.description: Webhook delivery results. Not part of the signed payload: webhooks receive the document without this key.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO 8601, second resolution, trailing Z.

tier.description: Freshness tier. Only `final` exists today; `provisional` is reserved (Discussion #178).

outcome.description: Summary of the jobs that targeted this session in this run.

rows.description: Rows this run wrote for this session: raw bars stored and canonical rows reconciled.

providers.description: Sources that contributed rows to this session in this run.

url_hash.description: First 12 hex digits of SHA-256 of the configured URL. The URL itself is never written (it may carry a token).

error.description: Short reason (for example `no_secret`, `HTTP 500`, `delivery budget exhausted`). Never contains the URL or the secret.
